page.overview:
Who is "Where the Redfern Grows" 5th grader?

The "Where the Redfern Grows" 5th grader is a member of the 5th grade class at Springfield Elementary School.

He takes part in the fight between the 4th graders and the 5th graders when he makes fun of their ignorance.
